summary.text: Jarren Hurt is the Democratic candidate for Indiana House of Representatives District 91 in the November 3, 2026 general election, in which he faces incumbent Robert Behning (R).

A U.S. Navy veteran, he works in utility construction and, in a Ballotpedia survey, named public school funding, universal pre-K and removing sales tax from residential utilities among his priorities.

paragraphs.text: Jarren Hurt served in the U.S. Navy from 2006 to 2011, graduated from Martinsville High School, attended Ivy Tech, and earned a bachelor's degree from Indiana University in 2015, according to Ballotpedia.
His career experience includes working as a construction worker.
In a Ballotpedia survey, Hurt's biography said he was born and raised in Martinsville, lives in Camby with his wife and three children, and served as a submariner in the Navy.
It describes experience in retail and small-business management, real estate, and utility construction, where he is a small business owner building fiber optic infrastructure.
He said he had not intended to run for office but did so because no one else signed up.

He listed direct state funding for public education and expanded universal pre-K as a key message, along with eliminating Indiana's 7% sales tax on residential utility services and requiring data center operators to pay what he called their fair share.
He also said he supports a two-term limit for elected offices.
